notes: Worked only from the packet, the named method/knowledge files and uie probe. No source, DESIGN.md, detector output or other evaluators' files were read. Probe evidence paths are relative to the run directory (runs/20261007-234926-audit-standard/). Two early probes (32, 40, 45) used text= locators on session labels; after one of them Continue appeared not to respond, but re-probing with the radio input selector (probes 56, 58) navigated normally, so no 'silent Continue' finding is raised (treated as a possible tooling artefact). Heuristics knowledge file (heuristics.md) was not opened separately; Nielsen H1-H10 were applied from the method file's definitions.

passes.summary: Walked find -> tool -> basket -> confirm -> done with probes at 375 px and read captures at 375 and 1280 px; mapped the two separate date choices (pick-up day on tool page, pick-up session in basket).

Element-by-element check of every route and captured state against H1-H10, with adversarial probes (no-match search, non-session day, day before availability, session earlier/later than day, alternative input formats, Escape on custom list, Remove).

Cross-screen consistency pass: search placement by width, session order by width vs DOM order, day vs session terminology and values across tool, basket, confirm and done, date formats, error-summary pattern on basket and confirm.

out_of_scope: 9 further tool-card links: same component as the exercised 'Cordless drill 18 V, combi, one battery' link (probe 81)
18 further calendar day buttons: same component; exercised 9/10/12/17 Oct representative of session, non-session and pre-availability days
3 further session radios (14, 24, 28 Oct): same component as exercised 10, 17, 21 Oct
2 further confirm error-summary links and the basket error-summary link: same pattern as exercised #phone link (probe 81)
'Find a tool' nav link and done-page 'Reserve another tool': same target (index.html) as the exercised library-name link
Confirm reservation with valid data: not submitted (the action triggers a reservation and an SMS promise); done state inspected from capture
coverage.per_heuristic: H1-H10 considered on every route. Nothing found: H8 on all routes; H10 on tool, confirm, done; H2 on basket, confirm, done; H7 on confirm and done.

candidates.title: Calendar accepts a pick-up day on which the library is closed
candidates.description: A pick-up day should be limited to the opening sessions, because tools can only be collected then. The tool-page calendar lets the member select Monday 12 October (no session); 'Reserve this tool' adds it with no warning and the basket then reads 'Pick up Monday 12 October'.
candidates.impact: First-time members who do not know which days are sessions may reserve for a day the desk is shut and arrive to a closed room, or carry an impossible day into the rest of the flow.

scope.persona: member reserving for the first time
scope.task: Reserve a tool to collect at a session

evidence.detail: click Mon 12 -> Reserve -> toast 'Added to your basket'; basket ARIA: 'Pick up Monday 12 October · one week · deposit £20'

factor_notes.frequency: Any member who taps a non-session day; 15 of the 21 days shown are non-session days.
factor_notes.impact: No warning at any later step; the day is carried into basket and confirm.

candidates.recommendation: Make non-session days non-selectable, or warn at selection.

candidates.title: Calendar accepts a pick-up day before the tool is available
candidates.description: A pick-up day should not precede the tool's 'Available from' date. For the pressure washer (available from Sat 17 Oct), selecting Saturday 10 October and reserving is accepted; the basket reads 'Pick up Saturday 10 October' with no warning.
candidates.impact: Members may expect to collect a tool that is still out with a previous borrower and make a wasted trip.

scope.task: Reserve a tool to collect at a session

evidence.detail: pressure washer, click Sat 10 -> Reserve -> basket ARIA 'Pick up Saturday 10 October · one week · deposit £30'; find page card says 'Available from Sat 17 Oct'

factor_notes.frequency: Tools with a later availability date (3 of 10 in the list).
factor_notes.impact: Not caught later in the flow.

candidates.recommendation: Disable days before the availability date.

candidates.title: Pick-up day and pick-up session are chosen separately and may contradict on the confirm page
candidates.description: The collection date should be chosen once and shown once. The member picks a pick-up day on the tool page, then must pick a session again in the basket; the basket does not preselect the matching session, and any session is accepted. After choosing Wednesday 21 October (or Saturday 10 October) with a pick-up day of Saturday 17 October, the confirm page lists the tool as 'pick up Saturday 17 October' and the session as 'Wednesday 21 October, 18:00 to 20:00'.
candidates.impact: Members, and the desk volunteers reading the reservation, may not know which date is real; members repeating the task have to enter the same date twice every time.

scope.task: Change the collection session while reserving

locations.snippet: You can collect at any of these sessions.

evidence.detail: confirm -> Change -> Wed 21 -> Continue; confirm ARIA: tools 'pick up Saturday 17 October', session 'Wednesday 21 October, 18:00 to 20:00'
basket with day=2026-10-17, choose Sat 10 -> confirm shows session 'Saturday 10 October' while tool line keeps 17 October
no session radio checked although day=2026-10-17 was chosen

factor_notes.frequency: Every reservation passes both choices; contradiction arises whenever the two differ, including the core change-session journey.
factor_notes.impact: Confirm page shows two different dates with no indication which applies.

candidates.recommendation: Derive one from the other (preselect the session from the day) and show a single collection date in the summary.

candidates.title: 'Change' from confirm returns to a basket with the current session not selected
candidates.description: Returning to edit a choice should show the current value. After 'Change' on the confirm page (session Saturday 17 October), the basket shows all six sessions unselected, so the member must re-find and re-select a session even to keep it.
candidates.impact: Members changing their mind mid-reservation lose their place and must recall which session they had chosen.

factor_notes.impact: Extra recall and selection; not blocking.

candidates.title: Search with no matches leaves the full tool list and an empty status
candidates.description: A search with no matches should say so. Searching 'sewing machine' leaves all ten tools listed and the status region empty, so the page looks the same as before the search.
candidates.impact: A member looking for a tool the library does not stock may think the search did nothing, or that the listed tools match, and keep scrolling or retrying.

factor_notes.impact: Ambiguous outcome; member may not realise the tool is not stocked.

candidates.title: Truncated tool names hide the detail that tells the two drills apart on phones
candidates.description: At 375 px card titles are cut to one line, so both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…'; the distinguishing 'two batteries' / 'one battery' is hidden. Category, deposit and availability are also identical, so nothing visible separates the cards.
candidates.impact: Members who know the tool as 'the drill with two batteries' must open each card to find it, and may reserve the wrong one.

full names visible at 1280 px

factor_notes.frequency: Phone users (the main device); affects most of the 10 names, decisively the two drills.

candidates.title: Search box moves from above the tool list on desktop to below all ten cards on phones
candidates.description: Search should sit in the same place across widths and before the results it controls. At 1280 px 'Search tools' is above the list; at 375 px it comes after all ten cards, near the footer, and results update above it out of view.
candidates.impact: Phone users, the main group, must scroll past the whole catalogue to search or filter by date, and may not notice the list changed above them.

candidates.title: Sessions are shown newest-first on screen while their reading and tab order is oldest-first
candidates.description: Dates should run in one predictable order. The basket shows sessions from 28 October down to 10 October (at 1280 px, 28 Oct alone on a first row, then 24 to 10 Oct), while the ARIA and focus order runs 10 October to 28 October.
candidates.impact: Members scanning for 'this Saturday' look at the bottom of a reversed list; keyboard users move through the radios in the opposite direction to what they see.

factor_notes.impact: Slower scanning; mismatch for keyboard and screen-reader users.

candidates.title: UK mobile in +44 form is rejected with a message that reads as if the field were empty
candidates.description: A valid number in a common alternative form should be accepted, or the error should say what is wrong. Entering '+44 7700 900123' gives 'Enter a UK mobile number, like 07700 900123', the same wording shown when the field is empty.
candidates.impact: Members who store or type their number in international form may not see what to change and retry the same entry.

candidates.impact: Members who type only the digits get an error that does not say the prefix is the problem.

candidates.impact: Keyboard users and members expecting standard select behaviour have no quick way out without choosing an option or clicking elsewhere.

candidates.description: Badges reading 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' are green while 'Available from Sat 17 Oct', 'Wed 21 Oct' and 'Sat 24 Oct' are grey; no legend or text explains the difference.
candidates.impact: Members comparing tools for Saturday may misread grey as 'not available' or miss that it signals a later date.
